# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the current release branch (`release-YYYY.M`) and the `main` branch.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for a security problem. Report it privately through
GitHub's "Report a vulnerability" form on the Security tab of this repository
(<https://github.com/appdirsdev/mobinspect/security/advisories/new>), including:

- the affected version or commit,
- steps to reproduce, and the impact you observed,
- any proof-of-concept material.

You will get an acknowledgement within 5 working days. We aim to ship a fix or a
mitigation within 90 days and will credit reporters who want to be credited.
No bug bounty is offered.
